names.name: play.score
names.description: This drum's score.

names.name: play.combo
names.description: Notes hit in a row; 0 after a miss.

names.name: play.maxCombo
names.description: The longest combo of this play so far.

names.name: play.gauge
names.description: The soul gauge, 0 (empty) to 1 (full).

names.name: play.gaugeClearLine
names.description: Where on the gauge the clear line is, 0 to 1.

names.name: play.gaugeCleared
names.description: The gauge is at or past its clear line.

names.name: play.gaugeFull
names.description: The gauge is full.

names.name: play.good
names.description: Notes hit GOOD.

names.name: play.ok
names.description: Notes hit OK.

names.name: play.bad
names.description: Notes missed.

names.name: play.accuracy
names.description: 0 to 1: GOOD counts whole, OK half, of the notes judged so far; 1 before the first.

names.name: play.course
names.description: easy, normal, hard, oni or ura.

names.name: play.goGo
names.description: Go-Go Time is on.

names.name: play.branch
names.description: The route the lane is on: normal, expert or master; no value when the chart has no routes.

names.name: play.roll
names.description: Hits on the drumroll under way; no value when there is none.

names.name: play.balloon
names.description: Hits the balloon under way still needs; no value when there is none (a kusudama is play.kusudama).

names.name: play.kusudama
names.description: Hits the kusudama under way still needs; no value when there is none.

names.name: play.beat
names.description: Beats since the chart's first timing point, following its tempo changes (fractional, told every tick; negative before it, still while the song stands still). A movie's frame from it, say start + Math.floor(beat * 40) % 40, plays one loop a beat in time with the song.

names.name: play.time
names.description: The song's time in seconds from the chart's start (negative during the lead-in).

names.name: play.duration
names.description: The chart's length in seconds.

names.name: play.bpm
names.description: The tempo at this point of the song, beats a minute.

names.name: play.meter
names.description: Beats in this measure (the time signature's upper number).

names.name: play.measure
names.description: Which measure the song is in, from 0 at the first bar line; -1 before it.

names.name: play.scroll
names.description: The chart's scroll speed here (its own changes, not the player's speed option, which is player.speed).

names.name: play.rollHits
names.description: Drumroll hits of this play so far.

names.name: play.balloonHits
names.description: Balloon and kusudama hits of this play so far.

names.name: play.notes
names.description: Notes of the chart on the route being played (a section not reached follows it), rolls and balloons not counted.

names.name: play.notesLeft
names.description: Of play.notes, those not judged yet.

names.name: play.nextNoteBeats
names.description: Beats until the next note on the route (rolls and balloons not counted); no value when none is left.

names.name: play.nextNoteSeconds
names.description: Seconds until the next note on the route; no value when none is left.

names.name: play.nextNoteKind
names.description: The next note: don, ka, bigDon or bigKa; no value when none is left.

names.name: play.level
names.description: The stars of the course being played; no value when the song has none.

names.name: play.progress
names.description: How far through the song, 0 to 1, in hundredths.

names.name: dan.rank
names.description: The dan course's rank, 0 for the lowest; no value outside a course.

names.name: dan.name
names.description: The dan course's name, as its series writes it.

names.name: dan.song
names.description: Which song of the dan course is playing, from 1.

names.name: dan.notesLeft
names.description: Notes of the dan course not judged yet.

names.name: dan.exam.count
names.description: How many requirements the dan course's panel shows: the length of the dan.exam lists.

names.name: dan.exam.type
names.description: A requirement's kind: soul_gauge, goods, oks, bads, combo, hits, score or rolls. oks and bads must stay under their target; the others must reach it.

names.name: dan.exam.target
names.description: What the requirement asks for (this song's, where each song has its own).

names.name: dan.exam.gold
names.description: The requirement's target for a gold pass; 0 when it has none.

names.name: dan.exam.value
names.description: Where the play stands on the requirement.

names.name: dan.exam.possible
names.description: The requirement can still be met.

names.name: song.title
names.description: The song's title.

names.name: song.artist
names.description: Who made the song; no value when the library does not say.

names.name: song.genre
names.description: The song's genre: jpop, anime, vocaloid, doyo (children and folk), variety, classic, game or namco.

names.name: song.source
names.description: Where the song comes from: stock, nijiiro, tja, osuLazer or osuStable.

names.name: song.stage
names.description: Which song of the credit or dan course this is, from 1; no value where the game shows no stage number (home).

names.name: song.finalStage
names.description: This is the credit's last song.

names.name: song.subtitle
names.description: The song's subtitle; no value when it has none.

names.name: player.name
names.description: The name of this drum's player (read with the drum's number outside a drum's own movie); none while the drum has no player.

names.name: player.side
names.description: This drum: 0 the left one, 1 the right one.

names.name: player.autoplay
names.description: This drum is played by the bot (autoplay, the attract demo, AI battle's AI-don), not a person.

names.name: player.replay
names.description: This play is a recorded one being watched again.

names.name: player.speed
names.description: The notes' scroll speed option, 1 for none.

names.name: player.doron
names.description: The vanishing notes option is on.

names.name: player.abekobe
names.description: The swapped notes option is on.

names.name: player.random
names.description: The shuffled notes option: 0 off, 1 a little, 2 a lot.

names.name: player.shinuchi
names.description: The true-score option is on.

names.name: player.tone
names.description: This drum's sound: an index of the tone.name list (the game's six: taiko, festival, dogs and cats, deluxe taiko, drum kit, tambourine). Read it with the drum's number outside a drum's own movie.

names.name: player.support
names.description: The helping-hand option (papa-mama support) is on. Always false for now: the engine does not have it yet.

names.name: rows.count
names.description: How many rows the library shows now (a folder opened in place adds its nodes under it): the length of the row.* lists.

names.name: row.kind
names.description: A row's node: folder, song, chart or course (a dan course: its charts are its songs). Only the rows of the window asked for (rows.window) have values.

names.name: row.depth
names.description: How deep a row sits: 0 at the top, one more under each open row.

names.name: row.opened
names.description: The row is open: its nodes are the rows under it.

names.name: row.title
names.description: A row's title: a folder's name, a song's title, a chart's song (in a course) or name.

names.name: row.subtitle
names.description: A row's subtitle; no value when it has none.

names.name: row.count
names.description: How many nodes the row holds; no value for one that holds none.

names.name: row.stars
names.description: A chart's stars; no value where there are none.

names.name: row.course
names.description: A chart's course (easy, normal, hard, oni, ura); no value for one without a course.

names.name: row.playable
names.description: The row can be played: a course whose songs are all in the library.

names.name: row.levels
names.description: A song's stars for each course, easy, normal, hard, oni, ura, comma separated, empty where the song has no chart of that course; no value for other rows.

names.name: selected.row
names.description: The row under the cursor.

names.name: selected.kind
names.description: The kind of node under the cursor.

names.name: selected.title
names.description: The title of the node under the cursor.

names.name: selected.bpm
names.description: The tempo of the song (or chart) under the cursor; no value when it has none or the cursor is on a folder.

names.name: scores.count
names.description: How many online ranks the chart under the cursor has (TaikOnline's top three for its course): the length of the scores.* lists. No value off a chart, offline, or before they arrive.

names.name: scores.name
names.description: A rank's player, best first.

names.name: scores.score
names.description: A rank's score, best first.

names.name: rows.window
names.description: The rows the movie shows: the engine gives row.* for those (up to 200) and drops the rest.

names.name: select.row
names.description: Moves the cursor to the row.

names.name: row.open
names.description: Opens the row in place (a folder, a song, a course): its nodes come in under it.

names.name: row.close
names.description: Closes the open row.

names.name: song.start
names.description: Plays the chart under the cursor (or, on a song, its chart of the select.course course), for every joined drum (the rainbow, then the song).

names.name: select.course
names.type: course: text (easy, normal, hard, oni, ura)
names.description: The course the movie shows: scores.* are the song under the cursor's for it, and song.start on a song plays it.

names.name: select.timeLeft
names.description: Seconds left to choose; no value while no countdown runs (at home). At 0 a movie picks what it can.

names.name: course.start
names.description: Plays the dan course under the cursor (refused when one of its songs is not in the library).

names.name: result.course
names.description: The course this drum's player played: easy, normal, hard, oni or ura. Each result.* is read with the drum's number (Wd.get("result.score", 2)); a drum that did not play has none.

names.name: result.score
names.description: This drum's final score.

names.name: result.best
names.description: This drum's player's best score on the chart before this play; no value for a guest.

names.name: result.good
names.description: Notes hit GOOD.

names.name: result.ok
names.description: Notes hit OK.

names.name: result.bad
names.description: Notes missed.

names.name: result.maxCombo
names.description: The longest combo.

names.name: result.rolls
names.description: Drumroll, balloon and kusudama hits.

names.name: result.gauge
names.description: The soul gauge at the end, 0 to 1.

names.name: result.cleared
names.description: The play cleared the song.

names.name: result.fullCombo
names.description: Cleared with no note missed.

names.name: result.continue
names.description: The results are done: go on (to the next song, the revival offer or the end of the credit, as the engine decides).

names.name: sound.play
names.type: name: text, drum: number (optional: 1 left, 2 right)
names.description: Plays the skin's sound of that name (drum.don, ui.ka, banner.clear, a name of the skin's own): for that drum's side and tone when one is given, else centred.

names.name: tone.count
names.description: How many drum sounds a player can choose from: the length of the tone.name list.

names.name: tone.name
names.description: A drum sound's name, for the selector.

names.name: tone.choose
names.type: tone: number, drum: number (1 left, 2 right)
names.description: This drum's player takes that drum sound (player.tone follows) and hears it once.

names.name: player.join
names.description: This drum's player joins (in coin mode, if the credits pay for it). player.joined says when it is in.

names.name: player.joined
names.description: This drum's player is in the session (read with the drum's number: Wd.get("player.joined", 2)).

names.name: entry.timeLeft
names.description: Seconds left on the entry's countdown, which starts with the first join; no value while none runs. At 0 a movie starts the session as it is.

names.name: entry.setup
names.description: The home player setup is open over the entry: it has the drums. When it closes, player.joined says who plays.

names.name: account.picking
names.description: Waddamburo's "who's playing?" is up: the left drum's player is chosen from Guest and the stored accounts (account.pick). A movie that listens to it shows the choice itself; else the engine draws its own list over the entry. The avatar of account i fills the clip acct<i>/avatar (a shape without a texture inside a clip named acct0, acct1, ...).

names.name: account.count
names.description: How many stored accounts there are (Guest not counted): the length of account.name.

names.name: account.name
names.description: A stored account's name, for the choice.

names.name: account.default
names.description: The account to start the choice on; no value: Guest.

names.name: account.pick
names.description: The left drum's player is this account (or a guest): the choice closes; the movie then joins them (player.join 1).

names.name: session.start
names.description: The players have joined: start the game in this mode. normal goes to song select, dan to the dan dojo's course select.

names.name: transition.phase
names.description: Only on the intermission movie drawn over the screen (the rainbow, the fade, the shutters): cover, then reveal when the engine uncovers the next screen under it (a shutter is replaced by the next screen instead). No value as it is shown. The engine waits for the movie to stop playing after each.

names.name: music.beat
names.description: Where the song playing now (a song select preview) is in its beat: the count of beats from its chart's start, fractional (negative before it); no value when no song plays or its tempo is not known yet. The pulse of a beat is its fraction (beat % 1).

names.name: music.bpm
names.description: The tempo of the song playing now, where it is (it changes with the chart's BPM changes); no value as for music.beat.

names.name: stage.width
names.description: How wide the stage is in movie units (720 tall): 960 at 4:3, 1280 at 16:9, 1680 at 21:9 and more for wider. Movies are made for 1280 and drawn in its middle (free-movies.md, Screen shapes); a movie that places things by script reads it to hold an edge.

names.name: screen.name
names.description: The screen up now: boot, attract, title, demo, entry, select, tutorial, danSelect, play, result, retry or gameover. The indicators show or hide by it.

names.name: credits.freePlay
names.description: Free play: a drum hit starts, no coins. False in coin mode.

names.name: credits.count
names.description: Coin mode: the credits inserted and not used yet. No value in free play.

names.name: credits.service
names.description: Coin mode: the credits are service credits (the operator's switch), not coins.

names.name: credits.toJoin
names.description: Coin mode: the credits still missing for the next player to join (0: one can join now). No value in free play.

names.name: credits.shown
names.description: The credit line is shown: false at home without the arcade overlay (Settings).

names.name: network.state
names.description: The link to the score server: online, checking, noToken, unauthorized, noInternet, unreachable, timeout, serverError; none when no server is set.

names.name: timer.left
names.description: Seconds left on the screen's countdown (the entry, song select, the pause menu's resume); no value while none runs.

names.name: timer.shown
names.description: The countdown is shown: false at home without the arcade overlay (Settings).

names.name: card.accepting
names.description: A cabinet takes a player's card now (paired on the score server's website): the attract loop and the entry. No value without a cabinet link.

names.name: card.code
names.description: The pairing code to enter on the website while cards are taken; no value when there is none.

names.name: card.codeSeconds
names.description: Seconds before card.code is replaced by a new one.

names.name: card.player
names.description: The name of a player whose card was paired and waits for the credit to start; no value when none waits.

names.name: revival.norma
names.description: The revival drum roll: the hits it asks for.

names.name: revival.hits
names.description: The revival drum roll: the player's hits so far (any part of their drum).

names.name: revival.timeLeft
names.description: The revival drum roll: seconds left; no value before it starts.

names.name: revival.result
names.description: The revival drum roll's outcome: success (the credit goes on) or fail (it ends); no value while it runs.

names.name: revival.done
names.description: The movie has shown the outcome: go on (song select after a success, the end of the credit after a fail).

names.name: gameover.done
names.description: The end-of-credit screen is over: back to the attract loop.

names.name: dan.passed
names.description: The dan course's outcome on its results: gold, red or failed.

names.name: dan.songsPlayed
names.description: How many of the course's songs were played (a failed course ends early).

names.name: dan.songTitle
names.description: A course song's title, on the course's results.

names.name: dan.songGood
names.description: A course song's GOODs.

names.name: dan.songOk
names.description: A course song's OKs.

names.name: dan.songBad
names.description: A course song's BADs.

names.name: play.voltage
names.description: Waiwai: the voltage both players share, 0 to 10000 (the gauge is voltage / 200 segments).

names.name: play.voltageNorma
names.description: Waiwai: the voltage that clears the song.

names.name: waiwai.section
names.description: Waiwai: the section being played, together or solo; no value between sections.

names.name: waiwai.soloist
names.description: Waiwai: the drum playing the solo (1 left, 2 right); no value outside a solo.

names.name: waiwai.normaReached
names.description: Waiwai: the voltage reached the norm (once a song).

names.name: ai.sections
names.description: AI battle: how many sections the song is cut into.

names.name: ai.section
names.description: AI battle: the section being played, from 1; no value once the last ended.

names.name: ai.progress
names.description: AI battle: how far into the section, percent.

names.name: ai.needle
names.description: AI battle: the territory needle, the player's territory less AI-don's, -9 to 9.

names.name: ai.emotion
names.description: AI battle: AI-don's mood, 0 (losing) to 4 (winning), 2 to start.

names.name: ai.good
names.description: AI battle: GOODs this section, per side (drum 1 the player, drum 2 AI-don).

names.name: ai.ok
names.description: AI battle: OKs this section, per side.

names.name: ai.bad
names.description: AI battle: BADs this section, per side.

names.name: ai.rolls
names.description: AI battle: drumroll hits this section, per side (AI-don's copy the player's).

names.name: ai.won
names.description: AI battle: whether the player won each ended section.

names.name: ai.sectionCue
names.description: AI battle: a third (true) or two thirds (false) of the section have passed.

names.name: ai.sectionEnded
names.description: AI battle: a section ended: whether the player won it, whether it was the last.

names.name: ai.result
names.description: AI battle: the battle's result shows: whether the player won.

names.name: result.waiwaiGauge
names.description: Waiwai's results: the shared gauge's segments at the end.

names.name: result.duet
names.description: Waiwai's results: the duet percentage (synchro notes both players hit).

names.name: result.rareHit
names.description: Waiwai's results: whether each rare note was hit.

names.name: result.aiWon
names.description: AI battle's results: the player won the battle.

names.name: result.aiSectionWon
names.description: AI battle's results: whether the player won each section.

names.name: result.aiRank
names.description: AI battle's results: the player's AI battle rank before the battle.

names.name: result.aiRankAfter
names.description: AI battle's results: the rank after it.

names.name: result.aiWins
names.description: AI battle's results: the player's total AI battle wins before the battle.

names.name: transition.title
names.description: Only on the intermission movie: it shows the song's title (the rainbow before a song); song.title and song.subtitle are told to it first.

names.name: transition.side
names.description: Only on the intermission movie: whose colour it takes, 0 the left drum, 1 the right, 2 both.

names.name: note.length
names.description: Only on a roll's own movie (its body and its text): the roll's length on screen in pixels, head to tail, every tick. The engine places the movie at the head, turned along the roll.

names.name: note.hit
names.description: Only on a roll's own movie: a hit landed on this roll.

names.name: note.judged
names.type: result: text (good, ok, bad), big: bool, kind: text (don, ka), hit: bool
names.description: A note of this drum was hit or missed; hit is false for a note that passed unhit (a bad with no stroke).

names.name: score.added
names.description: Points were just scored on this drum (a big note's two halves come as one).

names.name: combo.milestone
names.description: The combo reached a hundred.

names.name: roll.hit
names.description: A hit landed on this drum's drumroll.

names.name: balloon.popped
names.description: This drum's balloon burst.

names.name: balloon.started
names.description: A balloon came under way on this drum, needing that many hits; goGo: it starts in Go-Go time.

names.name: balloon.ended
names.description: This drum's balloon is over: burst, or its time ran out.

names.name: kusudama.started
names.description: A kusudama came under way on this drum, needing that many of its hits (with two drums, each adds its own to the one ball); goGo: it starts in Go-Go time.

names.name: kusudama.ended
names.description: This drum's kusudama is over: burst, or its time ran out.

names.name: beat.passed
names.description: The song reached a whole beat (play.beat's whole part), once each going forward.

names.name: measure.passed
names.description: The song reached a bar line (play.measure's new value), once each going forward.

names.name: drum.hit
names.type: side: text (left, right), part: text (don, ka), drum: number (1 left, 2 right)
names.description: A drum was struck, note or not, on any screen. A drum's own movie hears its drum; any other hears player 1's, or listens per drum (Wd.on("drum.hit", fn, 2)) for a cursor per player.

names.name: song.ended
names.description: The song is over and its result is known.
